---
title: Página en borrador
lang: es
draft: true
format: html
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      # The banner label comes from the `draft` language term, not an
      # English literal (bd-draft-banner-missing-hgx1gkqm). Quarto 1 uses
      # `format.language.draft || "Draft"`; q2 already ships the term
      # translated in resources/language/_language-es.yml.
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ["</i>Borrador</div>"]
        # Case-sensitive: this must not match the lowercase `content="draft"`
        # of the `quarto:status` meta tag, which stays English by design.
        - ["</i>Draft</div>"]
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - [
            "div#quarto-draft-alert.alert.alert-warning",
            'head meta[name="quarto:status"][content="draft"]',
          ]
---

Una página en borrador.
